title: Separate immutable native headers from DATA-only permanent homes with complete fixed-tape return
body:
## Result
Separate an immutable supplied Gamma6 HEADER from a DATA-only permanent HOME of extent V. The fixed-rank positive core remains unchanged. A34-tape wrapper validates returned extent, restores heads/private owners and commits to the same HOME. Header length E remains charged but no longer changes scientific field extent.

## Verification and limits
All five registered commands pass. Separate root and interface CPUs check complete rank-two calls, all1,373,214 retained instructions across ranks1..9, and small/large/small reuse with E12308>V6144. Both return-extent faults reject before HOME scatter. Entry is after reservation; producer, nine-Gamma conversion, packing, cutoff policy, full caller and faster nonleaf rate remain open. No assumption discharge or new kappa.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/borrowed-header-data-only-home

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; retain #6978, #7000 and the linked fixed-rank core/permanent-HOME predecessors. Review is disclosed AI checking, not human or formal-kernel acceptance.
